title: Cheese toasts with Savoy and apple slaw

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Everything here is a whole food or a traditional staple: cabbage, carrot, apple, yoghurt, mustard, bread, Cheddar and seeds.

supermarket.reason: Every ingredient is an everyday item at Tesco or any mainstream supermarket.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a knife, a grater, a bowl and the grill, and the techniques are simple shredding and toasting.

works.reason: Salting the slaw before dressing it and toasting the bread on one side before adding cheese both work; half a Savoy makes a generous pile of slaw for four toasts but still sensible.

honest_times.reason: Twenty minutes covers shredding, grating, cutting matchsticks and grating cheese, and the 10 minutes of cooking matches the slaw resting while the toasts grill.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning, including the chives and pumpkin seeds, is used in the steps, and the names match their ids.

seasonal_feel.reason: Raw Savoy slaw with new-season apple on cheese toast suits early October, and the cabbage is the bulk of the dish.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, clear and in plain British English.

hearty_healthy.reason: Wholemeal toast with cheese, a big vegetable slaw and seeds makes a substantial, wholesome snack a family would eat.
